productArea.name: Gift cards
productArea.scope: Search, filter, issue, and manage gift cards, including balances, tags, timeline events, activation, individual expiry, and default expiry settings. Editing linked customers, products, or orders is outside this area.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Catalog then Gift Cards, and issue a card or open one for its balance, expiry, tags, and timeline.
Choose Gift Cards from Configuration to set default expiry for issued and purchased cards.
